subject.name: Penetration Testers
subject.summary: Penetration testers (O*NET 15-1299.04), under prior written authorization with a defined scope and stop conditions, simulate attacks to find security weaknesses in networks, applications, and systems; they record re-checkable evidence, risk impact, and remediation advice, and re-test with system owners. Testing real systems without authorization is not part of the exercise on this page.
